name: My views
description: A New Tab page of your own: one field that starts an agent chat, then your three newest chats as cards.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats (title, state, folder, agent) to show the newest as cards.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click its card.
scopes.actions:run: Start a chat from the field, open a chat with no workspace, and open Search Everything.
